header: One passage visible, the rest a click away
lead: Two to eight panels of rich text behind a strip of tabs. Every panel is in the source before anything binds, so the band degrades into a stack of headed sections rather than into nothing.

panels.title: Without JavaScript
panels.bodytext: All the panels are rendered and none of them starts hidden. The page is longer, the tab strip is a row of buttons that do nothing, and every word is still there to be read, printed, searched and indexed.

panels.title: With JavaScript
panels.bodytext: The shared runtime binds the strip: one panel stays in the flow, the arrow keys move between the tabs, Home and End jump to the ends, and the roving tab index keeps the strip a single stop on the way through the page.

panels.title: When to reach for it
panels.bodytext: Instructions that differ by operating system, one product described for two audiences, prices per region, the same answer for private and business customers. Panels a reader works through in order belong in an accordion instead.
